Else, offer shall be summarily rejected. 3 No deviation from the stipulated inspection clause shall be permitted. The inspection shall strictly be carried out by the designated inspection agency as per the prescribed norms.

Warranty period of the supplied products from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of good s (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be subm itted by the contractor at the time of delivery of Goods. 5 EMD : Offers submitted without applicable EMD shall be summarily rejected. Railways have the Righ t to forfeit the Earnest Money Deposit if the bidder withdraws or revises his offer within the offer vali dity period. 6 PBG : 1. PBG from successful bidder should be received in purchase office within 21 days from the dat e of communication of acceptance of offer with respect to the purchaser. PBG may be submitt ed in the form of FDR/BG etc. 2. If the successful bidder does not deposit the PBG amount within stipulated time, then EMD sh all be forfeited and case will be dealt with as that of withdrawal of offer by the bidder as per e xtant instructions. 3. PBG should remain valid for a minimum period of 6 months, beyond the date of co mpletion of all contractual obligations including warranty period. 4. If PBG is submitted in the form of Bank Guarantee (BG) then it may be ensured that claim pe riod must exceed the BG validity period by atleast 6 months. 5. PBG shall be returned/refunded only after completion of warranty period as specified in contra ct. 7 It may be ensured that, the BGs/FDRs /Guarantee Bonds towards PBG/Performance Guarantee/Warranty Security etc are to be submitted in favour of Sr.DFM /S.Co.R ly/BZA only. Bank Details: State Bank Of India, A/c No: 10464670019, IFSC Code: SBIN0000948, Main Branch, VI JAYAWADA. Address for submission : Sr.DMM Office, DRM Compound, Vijayawada - 520001 8 Bidders may note that Delivery period shall be negotiable, but material is required urgently. Howeve r, quoting unreasonably long delivery period compared to the tendered delivery schedule may result in disqualification of the offer. 9 General Damages: Wherever PBG has been exempted for any reason and the supplier fails to supply goods as per conditions of the contract, as amended from time to time, Purchaser shall have the righ t to cancel the Purchase Order with General Damages @ 5 % of the contract value, not by way of pe nalty. These damages shall be treated as recoveries outstanding against the vendor and dealt with a ccordingly.
